## DL-096 — V1-060 part A: flaky tests, CI limits, speed fixes and the DL-067 lock cause

- **Type:** `IMPLEMENTATION RECORD` (V1-060, DL-071 answers 13 and 14; plan and step log ops/V1_060_PLAN.md)
- **Built:** frontend test time budgets (`testTimeout` 60 s, `asyncUtilTimeout` 15 s; TEST-FE-203 waits for its line), `certifi` 2026.10.23 (PYSEC-2026-4320), CI job limits (backend 60, frontend 30, PostgreSQL 120 minutes), the speed tool (`scripts/speed-test.sh`, `backend/speed/`), migration `20270320_239` (Invoices list index; the Rent nonpayment alerts page checks a set-based balance before the exact function), `20270321_240` (the Billing Run finish locks the run before the attempt: the slice 12 deadlock flake) and `20270322_241` (below).
- **DL-067 cause (owner yes 2026-10-25, decision card "Yes, use the fix"):** the intermittent `LockNotAvailable` came from PostgreSQL's automatic cleanup (autovacuum) holding SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE on an obligation table while `app.assert_payment_excess_eligible` asked for SHARE with NOWAIT. Proven with a busier autovacuum on a scratch database: the refund and deposit receipt modules failed with 55P03 in most runs. Migration 241: when the NOWAIT request fails and every session holding a conflicting lock on those tables is an autovacuum worker (no user in `pg_stat_activity`), the function waits at most 3 seconds for the same locks; PostgreSQL cancels the cleanup after `deadlock_timeout`. Any other session's lock is still refused at once with 55P03, so the deadlock reason for NOWAIT stays. After the change 10 of 10 busy runs passed. No rule, amount or answer changes; no test was relaxed.
- **Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule:** the speed limits (middle read 0.5 s, slowest read 1 s, scheduled Rent run 120 s for 300 Units and 10 years of history).
- **Migration head:** `20270322_241` (first written as 207 to 209; re-chained after V1-058's `20270319_238` in part B).
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-25.

## DL-097 — V1-058 R7b-6e: the Rent Invoice bills every Service a Lease holds

- **Type:** `OWNER BUSINESS DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-058 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-26 03:07, decision card "Should the Rent Invoice bill every Service a Lease ticks?", answer "Yes, bill every ticked Service" (the recommendation).
- **Decision:** every Service a Lease holds, not only Trash Collection, is billed on the Rent Invoice with the Trash Collection rules: a month is billed when the Lease's term and the Service's approval period cover the whole month; the rate is the one in force on the first billed day; the move-in month is charged by days (half-up to the cent) and a following month in full; each Service has its own line after the Trash Collection lines (first month, then following month, by Service name). A Service that covers only part of a month, or has no rate in force, stops that Rent Invoice (as for Trash Collection) until it is corrected.
- **Amends:** DL-020 (Internet and Monthly Cleaning not billable), BR-SVC-001 (no other Service without an owner rule). Builds on DL-075 (Services and rates in Settings).
- **Built:** migration 20270318_237 (commit 26e5d52), tests in backend/tests/test_billing_service_migration.py.
- **Release note:** before release, check that no Lease holds a non-Trash Service term that covers only part of a month or has no rate (V1-060 gate).
- **Numbering:** DL-096 is used on the V1-060 branch (migration 209); renumber at merge if needed.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-26.

## DL-098 — V1-058 R7b-7: electricity and water follow the Unit's Meters; a Unit with no Meter is not billed for them

- **Type:** `OWNER BUSINESS DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-058 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-26 03:53, decision card "How should a Lease with no electricity or water work?", answer "Meters decide (no Lease tick)" (the recommendation), after a Customer asked to rent a small store room that needs no electricity or water.
- **Decision:** a Lease has no tick for Utilities. Electricity and water are billed from the Meters on the Unit (BR-UTIL-003); a Unit with no Meter of a kind gets no Utility Invoice for it. When a later Customer needs electricity or water, staff install the Meter and add it in Utilities > Meters with its first reading. The Meter is dated the day it is put in, after the earlier Lease's hand-back, so its readings never belong to a Lease that closed without one. A Unit with no Meter at all on the hand-back day needs no final readings or final Utility Invoice, so its Final Settlement is not held for them (migration 20270319_238); any earlier Utility period with consumption on no Invoice still holds it. The Home "Refund due by" to-do (DL-073 item 4) for such a Unit counts 7 days from the final inspection alone. The New Lease form says when the chosen Unit has no electricity or water Meter on the Start Date, and a person with Settings access may add a Service from the form (the Settings rules of DL-075 apply).
- **Links:** BR-UTIL-003, BR-UTIL-020, BR-UTIL-021, DL-075, DL-097.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-26.

## DL-100 — V1-060 B6: a walk-in Lease is paid in full before it is signed

- **Type:** `OWNER BUSINESS DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-27, during the V1-060 owner test session: "Drafting the lease must has deposit textbox, and after draft complete, print the lease and let customer check. after check complete must pay. so I think receive money when click sign lease button, Receive payment form must appear, after receive complete, start processing the lease signed"; then the decision card "Build Sign Lease as 'receive the money first, then sign'?", answered "Yes, full total to sign" (16:56 UTC).
- **Decision:** amends DL-066 (walk-in deposit timing) and DL-064 (when Initial Rent is paid). (1) The draft of a walk-in Lease keeps a planned Security Deposit amount (append-only, `leases.draft`); a Lease from a Reservation keeps the Reservation's Security Deposit and a renewal keeps the one it carries. (2) Print draft gives the customer one A4 sheet to check before paying. (3) Sign Lease first receives the full total, with no part payment: the Security Deposit still owed (the planned amount for a walk-in, or the rest after the Booking deposit) plus the Initial Rent Invoice (Rent and the Services that cover the whole month). Then the Lease is signed, the Initial Rent Invoice is made at once and paid from that money, and the rest goes into the Security Deposit. The Initial Rent Invoice keeps its own Due Date rule (DL-064); only the time of payment moves to signing. The Sign Lease button no longer shows a MANAGER badge (owner item 3; the `leases.sign` permission still decides). Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule): the planned deposit starts at one month's Rent until staff type another amount; the Initial Rent Invoice number is `RENT-I-<yyyymm>-<first 12 hex of the Lease id>`. Migration `20270325_244`.
- **Links:** BR-DEP-002, BR-DEP-006, BR-RES-001, BR-LEASE-003, BR-RENT-005, DL-008, DL-064, DL-066, DL-077.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-27.

## DL-101 — V1-060 B6: the Security Deposit is a Lease term on every draft, including a Lease from a Reservation

- **Type:** `OWNER BUSINESS DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-27, during the V1-060 owner test session: "why draft lease still not has deposit textbox?", then "because on lease agreement paper will write amount of deposit even we have not received it yet. like monthly rent, we have not received it too. Yet, we write it on the lease. both monthly rent and deposit are not record in payment table. but must record in lease agreement table." This answered the decision card "Show the Security Deposit box on a Lease from a Reservation too?" with the recommended option "Yes, a box on every draft" (20:55 UTC).
- **Decision:** amends DL-100 item (1) and BR-DEP-004. (1) The Security Deposit amount is a Lease term like the monthly Rent: every draft Lease that is not a renewal records it with the Lease (`app.lease_planned_security_deposits`, append-only, `leases.draft`), not in the payment tables, before any money is received; the Lease page and the printed draft show it. (2) A draft from a Reservation starts at the Reservation's Security Deposit amount and may be changed with a reason; it can never be less than the money already received. (3) The Reservation's Security Deposit keeps its amount until signing; Sign Lease then records the draft's amount as one increase or decrease of the required amount of the same Security Deposit (BR-DEP-005), and receives the rest in full with the Initial Rent (DL-100). (4) A renewal keeps the Security Deposit it carries. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule): the change of the required amount is made right after signing under `leases.sign` (only the Security Deposit of the Lease being signed, at most once per Lease), and Sign Lease refuses to take money while the draft's amount is below the money received. Migration `20270326_245`.
- **Links:** BR-DEP-002, BR-DEP-004, BR-DEP-005, DL-100.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-27.

## DL-102 — V1-060 B6: Add occupant on a draft or a running Lease

- **Type:** `OWNER BUSINESS DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-28, during the V1-060 owner test session: "why can add occupants into lease after signed? customer leased unit 2 bedrooms which max occupants is 4. when signed the agreement he was alone. and later he want her friend to live here too. but I can't find way to add the occupants." The owner-approved DESIGN.md 0.15 (13/10/2026) already gives the Occupants card an "Add occupant" button; V1-058 step L2c-1 moved it to the R7 list because it needed a new database command.
- **Decision:** amends BR-OCC-004 and the Record move-in of DL-066. (1) The Lease page Occupants card has an "Add occupant" button on a draft or a running Lease, for staff who may record move-ins (`reservations.complete`); the person is an existing Customer or a new one made from the dialog. (2) Before anybody has moved in, the person is planned: the card lists them as "Moves in with the Lease" and Record move-in ticks them, so they get the Lease's move-in date. (3) After the move-in, the person gets their own Occupancy from their own move-in date, which is not before the Lease's move-in date, not after the End Date and not after today. The Rent, Signers, deposits and Invoices do not change: an occupant signs nothing and owes nothing (BR-OCC-006). (4) Each addition is append-only and shows in the Lease History; the move-in of a Lease signed with its outcome record (DL-066) now shows there too. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule): the Primary Tenant is not added again after the move-in (the Utilities responsibility follows the Primary Tenant's own Occupancy); a renewal adds people only after its own move-in (how a renewal's occupants move to the new Lease is still open, V1-058 R7); a deactivated Customer, a cancelled or terminated Lease, and a Lease where nobody lives any more are refused; at most 20 people are planned or living at once, as in Record move-in; a person already planned or living there is not added twice. The rules have no limit of people per Unit Type, so none is checked; the owner may add one later. Migration `20270327_246`.
- **Links:** BR-OCC-001, BR-OCC-004, BR-OCC-006, BR-LEASE-016, DL-066, DL-074.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-28.

## DL-103 — V1-060 B6: one Invoice holds many items

- **Type:** `OWNER BUSINESS DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-28, during the V1-060 owner test session: "Create Invoice Form: this form is not professional form. if there are 2 charge, I have 2 invoice for each charge? later, this app will have maintenance or repairing charge. there are many items in invoice. how could we create one invoice for one item or service charge?" On the decision card the owner chose "Yes, build it now" (10:01 UTC) with four rules: (1) the quantity is a whole number, the unit price is in US dollars and cents, and the amount is the quantity times the unit price exactly, with no rounding; (2) when a Customer pays only part of the Invoice, the money pays the items from the top down; (3) one reason and one approval for the whole Invoice; (4) at most 20 items on one Invoice.
- **Decision:** amends BR-INV-016, BR-PAY-036 and the Create Invoice screen of DL-074 (UI-049). (1) Create Invoice makes one Miscellaneous Invoice of 1 to 20 items. Each item has what is charged, a whole quantity and a unit price in US cents; its amount is exactly the quantity times the unit price, and the Invoice total is the sum of the amounts. (2) Each item is its own approved one-time charge, so each Invoice line still bills exactly one charge (DB-INV-005); every item on the Invoice shares the one reason and the one approval reference. (3) While the Invoice is a Draft, Edit items changes, adds or removes items with a reason for the change: an item that stays the same keeps its charge, a new or changed item gets a new charge, and an item taken off is withdrawn with that reason in the Draft's history. An issued Invoice is still changed only with Adjust or Void. (4) Issuing gives the Invoice its one number and its one Due Date (BR-INV-018); the printed Invoice lists every item with its quantity and unit price, for example "2 × $15.00". (5) A part payment pays the items from the top down, in the order they are listed. Damage items still come only from Move-out inspection findings; later repair charges are to use the same items table. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule): the quantity is 1 to 9,999 and the unit price at most $9,999,999.99; an item name on the screen is at most 80 characters; Edit items needs the Create Invoice permission (`invoices.create`) and works only on a Draft made with Create Invoice (not the move-out cleaning charge, a Damage charge or a correction charge); a changed Customer, Lease, reason or approval makes every item a new charge; the Final Settlement preview lists an item taken off a Draft as information, like a charge a draft correction replaced. Migration `20270328_247`.
- **Links:** BR-INV-016, BR-INV-017, BR-INV-018, BR-PAY-036, DB-INV-005, API-052, UI-049, DL-074.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-28.

## DL-104 — V1-060 B6: Report broken on a Utility Meter

- **Type:** `TECHNICAL DESIGN DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-28, during the V1-060 owner test session: "after found broken meter, how to report or change meter status?" The owner-approved DESIGN.md "Meter dialogs" already has Report broken: the date it was found broken and a reason, both required; the meter then shows "Broken since ..." in the error color and its readings are no longer accepted; there is no "stop without replacing" action, because a broken meter must be replaced (BR-UTIL-006, DB-UTIL-001; owner, 13/10/2026). Until now only Replace meter wrote the failure date, so a meter found broken stayed "Working" until the new meter was put in.
- **Decision:** builds the approved Report broken; no business or money rule changes. A person with `utility_meters.manage` (shown with the MANAGER badge, like Replace meter) opens a working meter that has a reading and reports it broken with the day it was found broken and what is wrong. From then on the meter shows "Broken since ...", its readings after that day are refused (the existing reading guard), Home no longer lists it as due, and the Meters list counts it under Broken meters with "Replace before" the next reading day. Replace meter keeps the reported day as "Found broken on" (the existing guard that keeps a failure date once set refuses another day), so the new meter can be put in from the next day. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule): the day may not be before the meter was put in or before its newest reading, and not after today in Phnom Penh; a meter is reported broken once and there is no undo, because a broken meter must be replaced; the report keeps what is wrong, who reported it and when, in the append-only `app.utility_meter_failure_reports` (one per meter), and the meter page shows what is wrong. Migration `20270329_248`.
- **Links:** BR-UTIL-006, BR-UTIL-007, DB-UTIL-001, DB-UTIL-002, API-044, UI-056, UI-057, DL-074.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-28.

## DL-105 — V1-060 B6: the final Utility Invoice says when no rate is in effect

- **Type:** `TECHNICAL DESIGN DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-28, during the V1-060 owner test session: Issue the final Utility Invoice for U201 showed "The hand-back was not saved. Check the date and try again, or read the Lease again." The cause: no Utility Rate was in effect on the day the Invoice was made. A Utility Invoice uses the Rate effective on its generation date (BR-UTIL-015, BR-UTIL-029), and Settings lets a new Rate start only on a reading day after today (DL-075), so the Rates set on 27/10/2026 started on 24/11/2026. The database refusal had no stable reason, so the route answered the generic `VALIDATION_ERROR`, and the move-out dialog fell back to a hand-back text that does not fit this step.
- **Decision:** no business or money rule changes. Asked whether the first Rate may start on an earlier reading day, the owner kept the rule as built (2026-10-28): a new Rate, the first included, starts on a reading day after today; for the test session the owner had the Rate dates of the local test database changed by hand (start 24/10/2026, tenants told on 20/10/2026). The final and catch-up Utility Invoice routes now answer 422 with the stable reason `UTILITY_RATE_NOT_IN_EFFECT` when no Rate of a billed kind is in effect on the generation date (the service names the database refusal "Generation-date Utility Rate was not found"), and the move-out final readings dialog says: "No electricity or water rate is in effect today, so this Invoice cannot be made yet. In Settings, Rates and services, a rate must start on or before today." Any other refusal in that dialog says "This was not saved. Check the values and try again, or read the page again." instead of the hand-back text. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule). No migration.
- **Links:** BR-UTIL-015, BR-UTIL-021, BR-UTIL-029, API-069, UI-078, DL-075, DL-074.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-28.

## DL-106 — V1-060 B6: Record kept Deposit on the Final Settlement step

- **Type:** `TECHNICAL DESIGN DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner, 2026-10-28, during the V1-060 owner test session: the Final Settlement of U201, whose Lease ended before its End Date, said "Not ready yet. First: A Manager records the kept Deposit.", and no screen offered a way to record it. Leaving before the End Date keeps the whole Security Deposit (BR-DEP-023), and the Final Settlement waits until the kept record is confirmed (BR-SETTLE-011, Q-2026-10-05-24). The route that records the keep draft (`POST /properties/{property_id}/deposits/{deposit_id}/forfeiture-drafts`, `deposits.dispose`, API-042) and its confirm in Waiting for approval (API-101) exist since V1-056 slice 11c-3, but no screen called the route.
- **Decision:** no business or money rule changes. The Final Settlement step of the Move-out page offers "Record kept Security Deposit" (or "Record kept Pet Deposit"), marked Manager, to a person with `deposits.dispose` (the Owner and Manager default bundles, not Staff) for each Deposit whose preview path is `FORFEITURE_REQUIRED`. The dialog names the Deposit, the whole held amount and the termination ground in plain words, asks for a reason (filled in with an English sentence that names the ground; stored records stay in English) and records the `LEASE_FORFEITURE` draft. Try again with the same reason sends the same record id and idempotency key; a changed reason is a new request. A draft that already waits closes the dialog and says so; the known refusals are named in plain words and any other shows the server's words. While as many keep drafts wait as Deposits need one, no button is offered: the kept line says its draft waits for approval, the blocker says the Owner or a Manager approves the kept Deposit in Waiting for approval (with a link for a person who may approve), and the general waiting-draft line is left out when every waiting draft is a keep draft. The server still works out the ground and the amount, and checks everything again at confirm. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule). No migration and no backend change.
- **Links:** BR-DEP-022, BR-DEP-023, BR-DEP-026, BR-LEASE-005, BR-LEASE-025, BR-LEASE-028, BR-SETTLE-011, API-042, API-101, UI-080, UI-081.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-28.

## DL-108 — V1-060 B7: Sign Lease and its money in one step, and a safe Try again in the money dialogs

- **Type:** `TECHNICAL DESIGN DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the final review of the V1-060 test-session fixes (B7, 2026-10-28). On the merge card the owner chose "Yes, merge after the checks" (16:35 UTC); the card said: "one last review of all the test-session fixes, because only reviewed work goes to the main line. If the review finds a real problem, I fix it and tell you before merging." The review found that Sign Lease saved its money, its signatures, its signing, its Initial Rent Invoice and its Security Deposit as seven separate requests: after a lost answer or a change by someone else, the money could be received twice, or a Lease could stay signed without its Initial Rent Invoice; and the money paid the Customer's oldest Invoices first, not the Initial Rent Invoice that DL-100 names. AGENTS.md asks for database transactions for multi-step financial operations. The review also found smaller points in Make Reservation, Receive Security Deposit, New Lease, Edit draft, some date boxes and the Reports screens.
- **Decision:** no business or money rule changes: who pays and how much stay as DL-099, DL-100 and DL-101 say; the fixes make the screens and routes keep those rules also when an answer is lost or a record changes meanwhile. (1) Sign Lease is one command in one database transaction (`POST /leases/{lease_id}/sign-with-payment`, `app.sign_lease_with_payment`). At the Lease version the screen showed, the server works out the money due at signing itself and refuses a Payment that is not exactly that total; then the Payment and its Receipt, every Signer's signature, the signing (completing the Primary Tenant's active Reservation of the Unit), the draft's Security Deposit amount, the Initial Rent Invoice, the money paying that Invoice by name and the rest going into the Security Deposit are saved together, or nothing is. The same request with the same key answers the same; the same key with anything else is refused. The separate Initial Rent Invoice and apply routes of DL-100 and DL-101 are removed. (2) Receive Security Deposit and Make Reservation send the very same request on Try again, the time the money came included, so a retry after a lost answer is neither refused as another request nor saved twice; a timeout, too many requests or a server failure (408, 429, 5xx) means "not known whether it was saved", never a refusal. (3) Make Reservation stops an amount below the suggestion before any money for a person without `reservation_deposits.override` (DL-099; the server refused it only after the Payment was saved), fixes the Rent together with the money once the Payment is saved, says so when the Unit or the Customer changed meanwhile, and keeps what was typed while the Reservations list arrives. (4) New Lease and Edit draft save the draft's Security Deposit as its own step: when the draft saved but its Security Deposit did not, the dialog says so and Try again sends only the Security Deposit; Close opens the draft. A Security Deposit that could not be read shows as not known, never as none. (5) Terminate, Move-out inspection, Meters and Letters take only a real day before anything is sent; typing digits in a date box adds the slashes, and the calendar gives the focus back to its button. (6) Reports: a Totals table counts whole months, so picked days widen to their whole months and the bar says "Totals count whole months."; the Total Payment note says a reversed Payment comes off in the month it is reversed; while only some rows are shown, the footer says "Total, all N rows"; the Audit chart title says when it shows only the last 31 days with events; the label on the highest chart column is its total with a reversal taken off, as in the table. (7) Drop-downs have their arrow back, small chart and calendar text uses the second text colour, and the dark first chart colour is #228456 (3:1 on the dark card). Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule (no money rule). Not built (follow-ups in ops/V1_060_PLAN.md): Make Reservation and Receive Security Deposit still save the money and the record as two requests (each now safe to try again); `POST /leases/{lease_id}/sign` (API-038) still signs without money, though the screen no longer uses it; the planned Security Deposit save has no `If-Match`. Migration `20270330_249`.
- **Links:** BR-DEP-002, BR-DEP-003, BR-DEP-004, BR-DEP-005, BR-RENT-005, BR-RENT-009, API-038, UI-040, UI-089, DL-064, DL-099, DL-100, DL-101.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-28.

## DL-109 — V1-060 B7 second review: a draft whose Reservation ended is not signed, and a lost answer keeps the money fixed

- **Type:** `TECHNICAL DESIGN DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BUILT ON THE V1-060 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the second review of DL-108 (B7, 2026-10-28), as the merge card promised ("If the review finds a real problem, I fix it and tell you before merging."): independent reviews of the Sign Lease command and its route, of the money screens and of the Reports screens. They found that `app.sign_lease_with_payment` still signed a draft Lease made from a Reservation that had since ended (cancelled, or expired, which DL-004 makes cancelled): as a walk-in with no Security Deposit, while it changed the ended Reservation's Security Deposit, which DL-009 keeps for that Reservation's own outcome. They also found that some definite refusals inside the command were answered as "not known whether it was saved"; that after a lost answer Receive Security Deposit and Make Reservation still let the person change the money and then sent it as a new Payment, so the money could be recorded twice; and smaller points in Make Reservation, the Lease page, the date boxes, the older drop-downs and the Reports screens.
- **Decision:** no business or money rule changes. (1) Sign Lease (migration `20270331_250`, same signature) locks the Unit, then the Primary Tenant's active Reservation of the Unit and the Security Deposit the draft names, before it works out the money. A draft that is not a renewal and names a Security Deposit that is not held for that active Reservation (the Reservation ended, or a new Reservation of the Unit holds the Unit) is refused before any money, and nothing is saved: "The Customer's Reservation of this Unit has ended or changed, so this draft cannot take its Security Deposit. Nothing was saved. Ask the Owner or a Manager." (`SIGNING_RESERVATION_ENDED`). The draft's amount is applied only to the Security Deposit the command took, and a Lease that is not a renewal must end with exactly one Security Deposit, received in full, or nothing is saved. A draft from a Reservation may still lower the Security Deposit down to the money received (DL-101). (2) The route answers an error raised inside the command as a refusal that says nothing was saved, because the command's transaction did not commit: dates that another signed Lease of the Unit covers are `SIGNING_DATES_TAKEN`; a way of payment that is no longer on is `SIGNING_PAYMENT_SOURCE_GONE`; another broken rule is `SIGNING_REFUSED`. Only a deadlock, a lock wait, a timeout, a lost connection or a failed commit is "not known" (503), and the screen then sends the same request again. (3) Receive Security Deposit and Make Reservation keep every box that makes up the Payment (in Make Reservation also the Reservation's dates, Security Deposit and reason) fixed after a lost answer, until the server answers. A refusal of the very same request proves that the lost one was not saved and opens the boxes again; "not signed in", "not allowed" or "not found" on Try again stays not known, because those checks come before the server looks for the request. When the money is saved but the rest is refused, the dialog says so with the Receipt number and says not to receive the money again. While the money may be saved, Close and Escape ask once more. After a lost Reservation answer, a refusal looks the Reservation up by its own id: when it is there, the dialog opens it; when there is none, the dialog says the money is saved with its Receipt and the Reservation was not; when the lookup cannot tell, it stays not known. Make Reservation does not keep a Unit from the address that is not vacant, waits for the person's rights before it allows less than the suggestion (DL-099), and counts a saved answer that cannot be read as not known. (4) The Lease page says when a draft's Security Deposit is being read or could not be read, never none, and closing Sign Lease reads the Lease again. (5) A date box adds the slashes only while typing at the end, never inside a date being edited or after a deleted slash, and takes no year before 1900; Escape on the calendar closes only the calendar. (6) Reports: the footer says "Total, all rows" with no number, because a report may join the server's rows into fewer lines; the Total Payment note says it matches the Payments report for the same whole months; Pick dates pressed again keeps the days typed; only the column with the highest total is labelled, at the height of what is drawn. (7) The older forms' drop-downs (for example in Settings and in Payments records) keep their arrow. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule: the refusal in (1) stops a wrong money step and does not change who pays or how much. Open owner question: should a draft whose Reservation ended be signed as a walk-in Lease with a new Security Deposit, the ended Reservation keeping its own? Until the owner answers, such a draft is refused and a new draft is made. Not built (follow-ups in ops/V1_060_PLAN.md): `POST /leases/{lease_id}/sign` (API-038) still signs without money; a planned Security Deposit save of the amount already planned does not keep its id from reuse; the records show the signing a moment before the money, in the same transaction; a retry after the person lost a right is refused although the first request was saved; the signing preview does not give the server's total for a walk-in draft whose Customer holds an active Reservation of the Unit (without `reservations.read` the dialog's total is refused as changed); Khmer screens show the server's English words for some refusals; the Edit draft deposit box does not follow a changed Rent; This month on a Totals table shows the days, not the whole month the table counts; Letters and Record notice give the order message for a date that is not a real day; one test with a date that is not a real day per dialog; the hover colour of chart columns. Migration `20270331_250`.
- **Third review (2026-10-28, no new migration):** an independent review of the DL-109 work found no serious problem; its smaller points are built. Sign Lease answers `SIGNING_DATES_TAKEN` only for the signed-Lease dates check (`leases_signed_period_exclusive`); another exclusion check is `SIGNING_REFUSED`. A way of payment switched off after the dialog opened is `SIGNING_PAYMENT_SOURCE_GONE`, like a missing source, and its words say "switched off". After a lost answer, a Try again that never leaves the browser stays not known too, in Receive Security Deposit and in both steps of Make Reservation; in the Reservation step "not signed in", "not allowed" and "not found" also stay not known, with no lookup. While the money may be saved, Escape only asks and only the "Close anyway" button closes the dialog; a held-down Escape counts once. Closing Receive Security Deposit reads the Lease again, and closing Make Reservation reads the Reservations list again. When the money is saved but the Reservation is refused as changed, the words do not ask to change the Unit or the Customer, which stay fixed. The Make Reservation Payment memo no longer depends on the screen language, so a request sent again stays the same. A whole day pasted as eight digits over a date box gets its slashes. Decided by Claude under the owner's 2026-10-23 22:30 rule: no change to who pays or how much. Not built (follow-ups in ops/V1_060_PLAN.md): Sign Lease and Cancel or expire Reservation lock in a different order, so a deadlock answers Sign Lease as not known (safe to send again) or fails that expiry run; a Reservation past its expiration day is refused only after the Payment step inside the command (nothing is saved); the signing preview still offers an ended Reservation's Security Deposit, and the refusal could say that a new draft is needed; after a lost Payment answer in Make Reservation, a first refusal on a later step shows not known; Back, reload or a link leave a money dialog without asking; the Reservation lookup reads "not found" as none even after the person's rights changed; a Try again after another person signed in on the same screen can read a refusal as not saved.
- **Owner answer (2026-10-29, decision card "Should a draft be signed after its Reservation ended?"):** "Keep refusing". A draft Lease whose Reservation was cancelled or expired, or whose Unit another Reservation holds, is not signed (`SIGNING_RESERVATION_ENDED`); staff make a new draft, and the ended Reservation keeps its own Security Deposit (DL-009). This closes the open owner question above; nothing else changes.
- **Links:** BR-DEP-002, BR-DEP-004, BR-RENT-005, API-038, UI-032, UI-040, UI-089, DL-004, DL-009, DL-064, DL-099, DL-100, DL-101, DL-108.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-28.

## DL-110 — V1-061: a Unit's default Rent and required Services, Utility prices on the Unit pages, and no signing without money

- **Type:** `BUSINESS RULE DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BEING BUILT ON THE V1-061 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner's bug list of 2026-10-29 04:10 ("unit details has no default unit price, default service that unit is required. And utility price information should appear on Units page or Unit detail page too.") and the V1-061 plan the owner chose on 2026-10-29 04:02 ("Bugs first, then V1.1"), which lists the old Sign route that signed with no money.
- **Owner answers (2026-10-29 04:17, decision cards, both the recommendation):**
  - "How should the Unit's default Rent work?" -> "Lower Rent needs a Manager". A Unit has a default monthly Rent (integer cents, or none). A new Reservation or Lease draft for the Unit starts with it. Staff may agree a higher Rent. A Rent below it needs a Manager or the Owner (the new right `rent.below_default`, in the default Owner and Manager bundles, never in Staff) and the command's reason. A Lease draft from a Booking may keep the Booking's agreed Rent, which was agreed when the Booking was made.
  - "How should a Unit's required Services work?" -> "Ticked and locked". A Unit lists the Services every new Lease draft for it must hold. The screen ticks them and staff cannot untick them; the database refuses a new draft without one (`LEASE_REQUIRED_SERVICE_MISSING`). Leases that already exist do not change.
- **Decision (built, migration `20270401_251`):** `app.units.default_monthly_rent_usd_cents`, the table `app.unit_required_services`, `app.unit_rent_terms(unit)` and `app.set_unit_rent_terms(...)` (at the Unit version; a Service must be of the Unit's Property; at most 20). A Manager or the Owner sets both with `PUT /units/{unit_id}/rent-terms`; each change is a `unit.rent_terms_changed` History event. A Rent below the default answers `RENT_BELOW_UNIT_DEFAULT` (403) on Make Reservation, on a new Lease draft, on a draft Rent change and on a renewal.
- **Also in V1-061 (no rule change):** the Units list shows today's electricity and water prices, and the Unit page shows each Meter, its price in force and the next price (read with `utility.read`). The plain `POST /leases/{lease_id}/sign`, which signed a Lease with no money, is removed; Sign Lease with payment (DL-108) is the only way to sign.
- **Not built yet (follow-ups):** a renewal draft made without terms does not take the Unit's required Services.
- **Links:** BR-UNIT-015, BR-RES-003, BR-UTIL-003, API-038, UI-026, DL-075, DL-098, DL-100, DL-108.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-29.

## DL-111 — V1-061: move out one occupant while the Lease runs

- **Type:** `BUSINESS RULE DECISION`
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BEING BUILT ON THE V1-061 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner's bug list of 2026-10-29 04:10 ("Lease details, Occupants: add move-out button for individual tenant. but Primary Tenant is not allowed to move-out.") and 04:22 ("If more than one signer, before move-out, other signer must acknowledge and agree. If one signer or only signer left, do not allow to move-out until termination processing complete.").
- **Decision:** a Move out button for each person on the Lease page (BR-OCC-010). The Primary Tenant never moves out alone. A person who signs nothing moves out on their own day. A Joint Signer moves out only when every other Signer of the Lease agrees; the Signers who agreed are kept with the move-out. The only Signer still living there is refused until the Lease's termination is complete. The day is from their move-in day to today and never after the End Date. Claude's reading, told to the owner on 2026-10-29 and not changed by them: a Joint Signer who moves out stays a Signer of the Lease and keeps its responsibility until it ends (the Signers of a signed Lease never change); a Signer who should stop owing needs a new Lease.
- **Built (migration `20270402_252`):** the append-only table `app.lease_occupant_move_outs` and `app.move_out_lease_occupant` (the move-in right `reservations.complete`, as Add occupant). `POST /api/v1/leases/{lease_id}/occupancies/{occupancy_id}/move-out` answers `OCCUPANT_PRIMARY_TENANT`, `OCCUPANT_LAST_SIGNER`, `OCCUPANT_SIGNERS_MUST_AGREE`, `OCCUPANT_MOVE_OUT_DATE` or `OCCUPANT_NOT_LIVING_THERE`. The Lease History shows each move-out.
- **Links:** BR-OCC-005, BR-OCC-006, BR-OCC-009, BR-OCC-010, BR-LEASE-006, API-038, DL-102.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-29.

## DL-112 — V1-061: Make Reservation and Receive Security Deposit save in one step

- **Type:** `TECHNICAL DECISION` (a fix on the owner's bug list; no new business rule)
- **Status:** `APPROVED; BEING BUILT ON THE V1-061 BRANCH`
- **Source:** the owner's bug list of 2026-10-29 ("Bugs first, then V1.1"): "Make Reservation and Receive Security Deposit should save in one step." AGENTS.md: database transactions for multi-step financial operations.
- **Decision:** the screens no longer save the money first and the Reservation or the Security Deposit in a second request. One request saves the Payment with its Receipt and the record that holds the money in one database transaction, or saves nothing. The same request sent again answers the same records; anything else sent with the same key is refused. As in DL-108 for Sign Lease.
- **Built (migration `20270403_253`):** `app.create_reservation_with_payment` (the Customer's own Payment, then `app.create_reservation` taking its deposit receipt from it) and `app.receive_lease_security_deposit_with_payment` (the Primary Tenant's own Payment, a walk-in Lease's Security Deposit when an amount is given, then the receipt into the Security Deposit), EXECUTE to `prm_financial` only. `POST /properties/{property_id}/reservations/with-payment` needs `reservations.create` and `payments.record` (and the deposit override or `rent.below_default` as before); `POST /api/v1/leases/{lease_id}/security-deposit/receive` needs `payments.record` and `payments.allocate`, and `deposits.manage` to make a walk-in Lease's Security Deposit. The money must be exactly the deposit accepted or received. The older two-step routes stay for other callers.
- **Links:** DL-099, DL-100, DL-101, DL-108, BR-DEP-002, BR-DEP-004, API-032.
- **Decision date:** 2026-10-29.
